correctness.rationale: Antipodal parity reduces evaluation to seven representatives, and the addition theorem gives exactly the reading's Legendre Gram rank. The even constant-sector block and the odd three coupled Fourier characters plus the uncoupled product character agree with the signed dot products. Independent Q(√3) elimination gave ranks (1,3,5,4,6,6,6,7,6,7,6,7,7,7,6) through 14 and full rank through 28 thereafter. At 14 the kernel vector has per-node weights 1 on axes and −729/1024 on corners. In the displayed orthonormal two-orbit block the coordinate ratio includes a factor 2/√3; the stated sampling functional and code use per-node weights. DLMF 18.14.3 at α=β=0 gives the Bernstein bound with degree ℓ+1/2, hence the weaker bound used in the proof. Since 72<(157/50)·29·(4/5), all six off-diagonal terms sum to less than one in each row from degree 29. The finite verification and positive-definite tail cover every degree, with degree 14 making the persistent threshold sharp.
